correctness.rationale: Proof covers all n>=4: unique cyclic recurrence, explicit Plücker inverse, exhaustive boundary by two cut edges, irreducible path-determinant complete intersections, rank-3 transversality using two diagonal and one cut-edge variations, closure of every boundary stratum, then published radicality implies prime. Generic transverse node follows from rank-two Schur complement and surjectivity. Standalone exact checker reproduces rank and transversality across n=4..8 only; tests are not the infinite proof.
